_説明: アナザー日本紀の登場人物（2026-10-27 から）。何度も出る人だけ設定画（sheet）を作り、全部の回で顔・髪・服をそろえる。make_images_lovart_chars.py（OneDrive\ClaudeBackup\tools\youtube）が読む。1回しか出ない人は、script.json の image_en に見た目を直接書く。2026-10-28 L001 で長政・久秀・村重・義昭・家康を足した（長政・久秀・村重は S001 の絵の指示と同じ見た目）。2026-10-28 L002 で消防士・鳶の親方・保科正之を足した
style_en: Japanese historical gekiga manga illustration: bold confident ink outlines, heavy dramatic shadows, rich warm colors of paper lanterns and sunset, painted backgrounds of feudal Japan, intense exaggerated facial expressions. Hand-drawn look, never glossy or 3D. Original style that does not resemble any famous anime, manga or video game.

nobunaga.name: 織田信長（40代後半）
nobunaga.desc_en: Oda Nobunaga, a Japanese warlord in his late forties: lean narrow face, sharp piercing eyes, thin moustache, traditional chonmage topknot, black kosode kimono under a crimson jinbaori surcoat.

mitsuhide.name: 明智光秀（50代）
mitsuhide.desc_en: Akechi Mitsuhide, a Japanese samurai general in his fifties: calm composed face, quiet serious eyes, thin short beard, chonmage topknot, plain pale light-blue kimono with grey hakama.

hideyoshi.name: 羽柴秀吉（40代）
hideyoshi.desc_en: Hashiba Hideyoshi, a Japanese samurai in his forties: short and small, wiry build, deeply wrinkled cheerful face with a broad grin, sparse moustache, chonmage topknot, golden jinbaori surcoat over a brown kimono.

nagamasa.name: 浅井長政（20代）
nagamasa.desc_en: Azai Nagamasa, a handsome young Japanese samurai lord in his twenties: strong jaw, earnest eyes, chonmage topknot, dark green kimono and navy hakama.

hisahide.name: 松永久秀（60代）
hisahide.desc_en: Matsunaga Hisahide, an elderly Japanese samurai lord in his sixties: shrewd narrow eyes, sly smile, grey chonmage topknot, grey goatee, dark purple kimono.

murashige.name: 荒木村重（40代）
murashige.desc_en: Araki Murashige, a stout Japanese samurai lord in his forties: round face, thick eyebrows, short beard, chonmage topknot, dark brown kimono and black hakama.

yoshiaki.name: 足利義昭（30代）
yoshiaki.desc_en: Ashikaga Yoshiaki, the Japanese shogun in his thirties: pale refined face, thin eyebrows, tall black eboshi court hat, white and purple court robes.

ieyasu.name: 徳川家康（40代）
ieyasu.desc_en: Tokugawa Ieyasu, a Japanese warlord in his forties: round face, sturdy heavy build, calm quiet eyes, chonmage topknot, dark brown kimono with a grey haori.

shoboshi.name: 現代の消防士（30代・L002）
shoboshi.desc_en: A modern Japanese firefighter in his thirties: short black hair, determined honest face, plain orange-and-silver protective turnout suit with reflective stripes and a plain helmet, with no marks, letters, numbers or logos anywhere.

oyakata.name: 鳶の親方（40代・L002）
oyakata.desc_en: An Edo-period tobi construction foreman about forty-five: stocky build, thick eyebrows, chonmage topknot with shaved pate, short plain dark indigo happi coat, white headband, tight dark work trousers.

hoshina.name: 保科正之（40代）
hoshina.desc_en: Hoshina Masayuki, a dignified Japanese lord about forty-six: calm wise face, chonmage topknot, formal dark blue kamishimo.

_声: 2026-10-28 から：登場人物のセリフは語り手（VOICEVOX 青山龍星（ノーマル）・13）と違う声で読む（スキル references/16 の3）。台本全体の "voices" に、出る人物の voice を写す。同じ回に出る2人が同じ声にならないようにする（同じ声の人物：別々の回にしか出ない組だけ）。声は仮決め。試聴は characters/_voicetest_2026-10-28/。各キャラの VOICEVOX 規約（収益化・内容の制限）は、初めて公開する前に確かめる
